snippet.title: Keeper - Official Announce Trailer | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
THE KEEPER SHALL AWAKEN

From Lee Petty and Double Fine Productions, Keeper is a story told without words in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and, joined by a spirited seabird, embarks upon a heartening tale of unlikely companionship and an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding.

Available October 17, 2025

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/keeper/9NCJWHHMVHR0

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
